Statement: Positive reviews contain the exact phrases and product mentions customers love, but marketing crafts promotions from intuition rather than the authentic language that already resonates in the review corpus.
Solution: Databricks Genie Code extracts praised products, attributes, and emotive phrases from highly positive entries in review, aggregates frequency across franchiseID, and compiles the winning language into a messaging playbook.
Business Value: The Brand Marketing Lead receives a ranked list of customer-authentic praise themes to seed campaigns, aiming to increase positive-review frequency in review and campaign conversion [ESTIMATE: depends on review].
Strategic Goals Alignment: Increase Revenue, Improve Customer Experience
Priority Reasons: Mining authentic praise phrases from the review corpus to seed marketing campaigns aligns with Increase Revenue, but the link to a revenue line is one step removed since conversion lift is not computable from the review-only schema.
Quality Reasons: Signal lives in review (free text) and franchiseID. Running ai_query sentiment filters positively polarized reviews, then ai_query entity extraction pulls praised product and attribute phrases. Aggregating phrase frequency grouped by franchiseID yields a ranked top_praise_themes metric per franchise. These authentic phrases feed the promotional messaging playbook, supporting the campaign-seeding outcome, though conversion impact itself is not measurable from this table.

Use Case: Identify Top Franchises to Grow Revenue
Description: Rank Franchises by Customer Advocacy Strength with Best-Practice Replication Plan
Statement: Franchises generate differing volumes of positive advocacy in customer reviews, but leadership lacks a defensible ranking of which locations consistently delight customers and why, leaving proven practices unshared across the network.
Solution: Databricks Genie Code scores each review in review for sentiment polarity, aggregates net-positive advocacy per franchiseID over review_date, and ranks franchises so leaders can replicate the behaviors of top performers.
Business Value: The Franchise Operations Director receives a ranked advocacy scorecard that reprioritizes which locations to study and replicate, aiming to increase the share of positive reviews in review and lift repeat-visit revenue [ESTIMATE: depends on franchiseID].
Strategic Goals Alignment: Improve Customer Experience, Enable Data-Driven Decisions
Priority Reasons: Advocacy ranking identifies top-performer behaviors to replicate; a positive-advocacy ranking question that overlaps with the sentiment cases but focuses on best-practice replication.
Quality Reasons: review scored by ai_query sentiment polarity, aggregated to net-positive advocacy per franchiseID across review_date into a weighted advocacy index for ranking. ai_query explains top-performer drivers for a best-practice replication plan, aiming to raise positive-review share and repeat-visit revenue [ESTIMATE: depends on franchiseID].

Use Case: Close Service Gaps to Improve Customer Experience
Description: Detect Franchises Lagging the Network Sentiment Average with Coaching Priority List
Statement: Some franchises persistently trail the network in review sentiment, but without a statistical comparison against peers, operations cannot tell genuine underperformers from normal variation and misallocates coaching effort.
Solution: Databricks Genie Code scores sentiment per review, computes each franchise's sentiment deviation from the network mean over review_date, and isolates statistically significant laggards for coaching.
Business Value: The Regional Operations Manager receives a coaching priority list that focuses field support on statistically confirmed laggards, aiming to lift below-average sentiment in review per franchiseID [ESTIMATE: depends on franchiseID].
Strategic Goals Alignment: Improve Customer Experience, Enable Data-Driven Decisions
Priority Reasons: Benchmarking franchise sentiment against the network mean with significance testing targets coaching effort; a distinct comparative question versus the trend-decline cases.
Quality Reasons: review scored by ai_query sentiment, aggregated to per-franchiseID mean and compared against the network mean across review_date, with significance testing to separate real laggards from variance. Produces a ranked deviation KPI feeding a coaching priority list. Grounded in existing columns; the peer-comparison framing distinguishes it from the trend cases.

Use Case: Prevent Fake Review Manipulation to Protect Reputation
Description: Detect Duplicate or Fake Review Clusters with Moderation Investigation Queue
Statement: Coordinated fake or duplicated reviews distort franchise reputation signals and mislead operational decisions, but near-identical text chunks are not currently flagged for moderation.
Solution: Databricks Genie Code embeds chunked_text, clusters chunks with DBSCAN to find dense near-duplicate groups within and across franchiseID, then uses ai_query to explain each suspicious cluster and build a moderation investigation queue keyed by review_uri.
Business Value: The Trust and Safety Lead triages suspected manipulation faster, reducing the count of near-duplicate chunks in chunked_text that corrupt reputation metrics tied to review_uri [ESTIMATE: depends on chunked_text].
Strategic Goals Alignment: Improve Customer Experience, Enable Data-Driven Decisions
Priority Reasons: Flagging coordinated fake review clusters protects reputation signals, an indirect driver of Increase Revenue. The outcome is risk mitigation (quality of reputation metrics) rather than a directly computable P&L line, so ROI is moderate.
Quality Reasons: Text embeddings are generated on chunked_text, then DBSCAN clusters dense near-duplicate groups within and across franchiseID. Cluster tightness scored using review_date proximity produces a suspiciousness score per cluster. ai_query explains each cluster, and the moderation queue is keyed by review_uri, giving the Trust and Safety Lead a triage-ready list that reduces near-duplicate corruption of reputation metrics.
